creator: Alexander Terp
description: Panes run with TERM=xterm-ghostty. ssh forwards TERM, and a host without that terminfo entry treats the terminal as unknown (curses programs fail or degrade). Ghostty users hit the same thing; Ghostty's ssh-terminfo shell feature fixes it but needs a Ghostty binary, so Muster keeps it off. Muster could carry an equivalent (install the entry on first ssh, or fall back to xterm-256color for ssh).
title: ssh from a pane to a host without the xterm-ghostty terminfo
